name: ui/typing-indicator
title: Typing indicator
title_vi: Ba chấm "đang gõ" của khung chat
desc_vi: Bong bóng ba chấm nảy ra (phóng 0,6 lên 1 trong 0,1 giây), ba chấm nhún sóng khi chờ tin trả lời, rồi biến mất khi tin nhắn đến.
params_vi: size: bề rộng bong bóng (80 đến 220 px) · tone: dark | light · tail: on | off (đuôi bong bóng) · wave: true | false (ba chấm nhún) · hold: giây trước khi biến mất (null = ở lại) · x, y: vị trí góc trên trái (px), để null thì ở giữa
notes: Geometry (em based on size, default 124 px), colours (dark #242428 / light #e9e9eb, dots #8e8e93), the pop-in (scale 0.6 -> 1, alpha 0.4 -> 1, 0.10 s power2.out) and the bounded dot wave (-9 px at 124 px, scaled with size; 0.28 s sine.inOut, yoyo, repeat 5, dots offset 0.14 s) are the source's; the wave offset (0.15 s after the pop) and the dismiss time come from the source's demo and integration note. Differences: the source is a snippet that the composition drives, the block builds the bubble in the target box (centred, or at x / y) and runs pop-in, wave and the hard-cut dismiss itself (hold param, default 2.2 s as in the source demo, null = stays); an outer box carries the show/hide so the bubble does not flash before `at`. The 'hf-ui' design-token block of the source (unused by this component) is dropped. Imitates the iMessage typing bubble (brand_ui).
